newsitem.title: USA: BPA confirms 1,158 MW Wash. nuclear unit outage.
newsitem.headline: BPA confirms 1,158 MW Wash. nuclear unit outage.

text.p: The 1,158 megawatt (MW) WNP-2 nuclear power unit will begin its annual outage on Saturday, much earlier than planned, due to this year's abundance of hydropower, Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) confirmed Tuesday.
The plant will begin to ramp down Friday and be completely off-line by Saturday, a BPA spokeswoman said.
WNP-2 will operate at 90 percent power through peak hours on Friday, she noted.
The nuclear unit had been slated to shut April 18 for a 60-day refueling and maintenance outage, but BPA expects to have plenty of lower-cost hydropower as the spring runoff begins.
WNP-2's annual outage underwent a similar extension last year, when the plant was shut from early March and mid-July.
